title: 皐月賞の後に・ジャンプ&キャッチ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After an intense battle for first place in the Satsuki Sho, Tamamo Cross emerges victorious… but barely able to stand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then finds an unlikely friend in Gold City, whose flashy looks also make her a target. Recognizing each other's skills, the two vow to keep fighting in future races.
